title: Mythic Suffixes
html:
Rainbow (mythic) items have a fixed base name. When the client rolls a mythic, it can also attach one of these name endings. The ending is a real modifier: the same word always comes from the same stat bonus in that pool.

Existing wiki pages that list “Brilliance (Do Not Remove Label)” are the base name plus one of these endings. This page is the full client list, grouped by the ModPAL that owns it. Placeholders labeled NEEDS ENTRY in the dump are omitted.

See Modifiers for how names are stacked, and a rainbow item page for that item’s fixed base mods.
